record.one_liner: LinkedIn Ads (Advertising API) for managing ad accounts, campaigns, targeting and reporting on LinkedIn.
record.auth_notes: Member (3-legged) OAuth 2.0 is required for Marketing APIs; 2-legged application auth is not supported for them.
record.access_notes: Self-serve developer app, but Advertising API permissions must be approved via the Developer Portal (Products tab, add Advertising API). Development tier allows up to 5 ad accounts.
record.api_notes: Versioned REST endpoints under api.linkedin.com/rest covering ad accounts, campaign groups, campaigns, targeting facets/entities and audience counts. Some permissions (e.g. audiences) require approval as an Advertising API partner. Marketing version 202601 sunsets 2027-01-15.
record.blocker_notes: Advertising API product must be approved by LinkedIn before real ad-account access; no official LinkedIn MCP server found.

evidence.quote: The LinkedIn API uses OAuth 2.0 for member (user) authorization and API authentication.
Developers seeking to build a marketing related integration using Advertising API permissions must be approved.
First-party building blocks, no official MCP
This MCP server connects Claude Desktop (or any MCP-compatible client) to the LinkedIn Marketing API
Most permissions and partner programs require explicit approval from LinkedIn.
